purpose: Complete the missing host-neutral truth seam between exact DAW workspace/runtime identity and the already-built capability resolver: persist append-only verified capability observations bound to the exact current workspace observation and host-runtime fingerprint, derive the current capability-by-environment state without letting stale observations survive a runtime/workspace change, and build StudioCapabilityProfile candidates only from explicit current evidence rather than caller-invented verification flags.

lineage.outcome: N0TE can truthfully distinguish what an exact DAW/runtime environment has verified, lacks, or has not yet proven, so later adapters and creative jobs do not advertise capability from a DAW name, historical maturity or caller assertion alone.
lineage.capability: Verified capability x host x exact environment evidence feeding the peer-neutral StudioCapabilityProfile and CapabilityResolver

legacy_rejections: capability inferred from DAW family/name alone
adapter-provided artist preference masquerading as environment evidence
stale capability truth surviving runtime/workspace observation changes
automatic capability claims from installed plugin names
real-host support claims without observed evidence

completion_proof: a capability observation is append-only and bound to one canonical workspace, its exact current workspace observation ID and exact host-runtime fingerprint

the observation records capability, stable route identity/kind, availability truth, evidence reference and environment-derived scoring attributes needed by CapabilityCandidate without using host family/brand as a score bonus
artist user_preference is not persisted as environment evidence; derived candidates remain neutral until a separately owned artist-preference contract exists
verified AVAILABLE and verified UNAVAILABLE truth require explicit evidence; UNKNOWN remains representable and unverified rather than disappearing
a workspace/runtime observation change makes prior capability observations stale for current resolution instead of silently carrying them forward
current capability state is derived deterministically from append-only history; an older late probe cannot supersede newer evidence and SQLite enforces non-regressing observation time
one stable route ID cannot silently switch route kind inside one exact environment; the database and reopen validation fail closed on route-kind drift
StudioCapabilityProfile can be built from the current evidence state so CapabilityResolver no longer needs callers to invent verified/compatible flags for host-native candidates
peer-host behavior is identical for Ableton Live, FL Studio, Logic Pro, Pro Tools, Studio One, REAPER and GENERIC_OTHER; no host gets scheduling, scoring or truth priority
workspace/Song/profile isolation is preserved and capability evidence cannot cross workspace observation or host-runtime boundaries
capability evidence writes create inspectable canonical Activity history but do not mutate Song/version/assets, Session history, Host Shadow, FocusContext, Operations, DAWs or providers
corrupt/tampered persisted capability evidence or missing schema hooks fail closed on reopen
authored unit/integration proof remains separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution is UNOBSERVED
next_selection_rule: After DAW-00F lands, globally re-audit DAW-00 remaining requirements and all eligible nodes. Do not automatically continue to a host adapter: compare consumer Workspaces/Health reachability, environment fingerprint expansion, portability/integration chassis, remaining Song outcomes and OPS-04 by customer value and truthful substrate.
